name: fleeting_flight_prevention_ends_with_the_turn
notes: Printed: 'It gains flying until end of turn. Prevent all combat damage that would be dealt to it this turn.' Seat 0 casts Fleeting Flight on its 2/2 in its first main phase (a 3/3 with a +1/+1 counter). On seat 0's next turn the flying and the prevention are gone: the 3/3 attacks, seat 1's 4/4 can block it (no flying) and its 4 combat damage kills it.
